product.name: Water-based Adhesive for Studio Acoustic Foam Panels
product.description: This water-based Studio Foam Panel Adhesive is perfect for mounting our acoustic panels. One tube will install about 16-24 square feet of acoustic panels.Whether you're recording original music or doing a podcast, the difference between bad sound and a professional project can be the recording environment itself. Sound bounces and most untreated rooms will produce unwanted acoustic effects, easily deteriorating the quality of otherwise good recordings. Acoustic treatment corrects "bad-sounding" rooms, improving the quality of your projects. Our acoustic panel packs are easy to install and will deliver a substantial improvement for your recordings with very little investment.Our panels can improve the acoustics of a room with as little as 20% coverage. With 12 pieces per box, a few boxes of our 12" x 12" panels will make any room or home studio recording ready. Attach the panels in a checkerboard fashion on the front and back walls of your room to minimize reflections and standing waves.Our Bass Traps come in pairs and help minimize natural room reverb and standing waves when installed in the corners of the room.Updated Dec 6, 2019, 2019
